module: Ubuntu 18.04 Kernel Crypto API Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates random strings whose strength is modified by available entropy
description: The Ubuntu 18.04 Kernel Crypto API module is a software module running as part of the operating system kernel that provides general purpose cryptographic services.
tested_configurations: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS 64-bit running on Supermicro SYS-5018R-WR with Intel Xeon CPU E5 with PAA
Ubuntu 18.04 LTS 64-bit running on Supermicro SYS-5018R-WR with Intel Xeon CPU E5 without PAA (single user-mode)
allowed_algorithms: NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength)
